title: iRacing Track Guide: SRF at Mid-Ohio Chicane

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: brake just before the 150 marker, roll on and off about half brake pedal
corners.line: turn in about the 100 marker, take the dip, apex slightly banking
corners.exit: full power as quickly as possible, be ready for understeer on exit dip
corners.mistakes: don't lift too much on the track rise, avoid cutting course by hitting the yellow curb too much

corners.braking: third gear brake hard about 250 and turn in at about the 100 mark trailing in some
corners.line: turn in at about the 100 mark trailing in some
corners.exit: look for the honda billboard if you can't see it you're probably too early here
corners.mistakes: i'm a tad too early with my apexing and power and it cost me at least a tenth down the straightaway

corners.label: T4
corners.braking: third gear brake just as you center out the steering
corners.line: aim for the medium grey patch that you can just barely see the start of
corners.exit: roll on to full power when the tires will let you
corners.mistakes: if you stay tight to the curbing you'll be forced into a longer wider radius that will prevent you from getting to power as quickly

corners.label: T5
corners.line: turn in and get almost all of your steering done before the crest of the hill
corners.exit: balance the car with throttle if needed
corners.mistakes: too early with a little bit too much steering input

corners.braking: brake pedal will work better than a faster shorter stab as it won't affect your balance as much
corners.line: hug the right side wall as close as you can
corners.exit: roll on about half break at about 200 and turn in at the grass verge apex right at the beginning of the curbing but be careful for the easy one x that's right there the car will understeer badly after apex
corners.mistakes: tapping the wall can often break your car so don't do that

corners.line: stay to the right at the approach
corners.exit: use the car's oversteer to help you turn in get to full power by the time you can see the start finish tower and center out your steering for the final

general_tips: look for the gap in the tree line as a reference point that big gap is parallel to the track out curving and the end of the gap in the tree line is where the curving ends
